note: two white unlit quads under the world Fog (red, range 20), the right one without fogCoord (distance fog, about half at 9.9 units), the left one with depths 0 0 1 1 (bottom row clear, top row fully fogged, interpolated between). Probed from the composited frame in both engines; the body's neutral tone map shifts pure colours, so the tolerances are 25 to 45. With the Fog off a FogCoordinate fogs nothing.
gaps: compared with X_ITE 16.6.0 in the picture (silhouette 1.0, mean abs diff 1.1 of 255, Chromium 153 SwiftShader)
only IndexedTriangleSet and the bridged geometry sets take a fogCoord; IndexedFaceSet and the others the stock reader draws do not have the field
the fog is a second copy of the mesh drawn over the first with vertex alpha = depth, so it blends after the surface is tone mapped (X_ITE blends inside the shader)
vertices past the end of depth read as 0 (clear)
the world Fog is new to the bridge (stock body never drew it): it fogs every mesh no LocalFog covers; all fogs share the fog law of the first active one
